description: Capture a previously authorized payment via POST /v2/payments/authorizations/{id}/capture. Pass an amount object for partial captures, or omit to capture the full authorized amount. Set final_capture=true on the last partial capture.

amount.description: Optional amount object { currency_code, value } for partial capture. Omit for full.

authorizationId.description: PayPal authorization id (from a prior authorize_order).

body.description: Additional capture body fields merged into the request.

final_capture.description: Set true on the final partial capture to release any remaining authorized funds.

invoice_id.description: Merchant-side invoice id recorded with the capture.

note_to_payer.description: Optional note shown to the payer in the PayPal account history.

name: capture_authorization
